findings.title: stripe_checkout_session_id validation relaxed for one-off purchases (beyond spec)
findings.spec_requirement: Note #9B-5 specifies validation relaxation only for subscription records created at checkout
findings.evidence: Implementation has: validates :stripe_checkout_session_id, presence: true, if: -> { one_off? && stripe_invoice_id.blank? }. The spec only shows subscription-related relaxation. This additional relaxation is necessary for the invoice.paid top-up flow (Note #4) where one-off purchases are created from invoices without checkout sessions. Functionally correct but undocumented scope deviation.
findings.recommendation: Non-blocking. The relaxation is required by the invoice.paid top-up flow.
